title: runs/<run-id>/artifacts/data/bia.yaml
description: The system business impact and criticality analysis (P-8, ART-BIA; C-2 adds reevaluations): whether mission critical functions are present and which, the mission and business processes the system supports with the impact of their disruption, the users' recovery time requirement and interdependencies, the external stakeholders that depend on them, and the reevaluations a conflict with the categorization triggers. P-10, P-14, P-15, C-2, S-1, S-2, S-4 and I-1 read it; the S-4 contingency BIA (contingency.yaml bia) refines it. The criticality block is the SP 800-161 Appendix G criticality analysis, iterated at P-8 (Frame), C-2 (Assess) and M-1 (Monitor). BIA-001 to BIA-003 judge it.

mission_critical.title: Whether mission critical functions are present within the system

functions.title: Mission critical functions the system supports, none when mission_critical is false

processes.title: The processes below that carry the function
Mission and business processes the system supports, with the impact of their disruption

disruption_impact.title: Impact on the process if the system is disrupted, in FIPS 199 levels

recovery_time_hours.title: The users' recovery time requirement for the process

interdependencies.title: Systems, components and services the process depends on through the system

external_dependents.title: External stakeholders that depend on the system's critical functions or processes, and how that is communicated

communicated.title: How the dependency is understood and communicated to the stakeholder

reevaluations.title: Reevaluations by the mission and data owners of a process whose disruption impact exceeds the availability impact of the categorization

by.title: Who reevaluated: the mission owner (PER-SPONSOR) and the data owner (PER-IO)

criticality.title: The criticality analysis of SP 800-161 Appendix G: its iterations in Frame (P-8), Assess (C-2) and Monitor (M-1), and the prioritized list of critical processes, systems and components it narrows to

iterations.title: Each iteration of the criticality analysis: Frame at P-8, Assess at C-2 updating it, Monitor at M-1 for a change warranting iteration

step.title: Risk management step of the iteration

change.title: Monitor: the change that warranted the iteration

summary.title: What the iteration found or refined

critical_items.title: The narrowed, prioritized list of critical processes, systems and system components, rank 1 the most critical

rank.title: Priority of the critical item, 1 the highest; ranks run 1 to n

item.title: The process (BP-nn), the system, or the boundary component (CMP-...)

role.title: Why it is critical: it carries a mission process, delivers a defensive and commonly shared process (access control, identity management, crypto), or is enabling infrastructure with unmediated access (power supply)
